Headline: Iran war live: Tehran demands 7 conditions be met before holding any talks with US
Published 24 November 2026, by Mariem Bah and Daniel Khalili-Tari.
- Iran's parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says Tehran won't hold talks or take action until the US meets Iran's seven conditions, warning of a decisive response and a wider battlefield if enemies miscalculate.
- The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says three oil tankers "suffered a severe explosion and fire after hitting naval mines" in the Strait of Hormuz.
